discussions.prompt: What remains unresolved beyond the PqsBC net HHQ formation assay?
discussions.rationale: Accession nodes are native PAO1 references, not full expression-plasmid sequences. The crystal contains C129A and an altered PqsC N-terminus. The paper interprets a heterodimer, whereas current deposition assemblies are tetrameric; physiological stoichiometry is not settled here. The elementary ring-closing step remains unassigned. No PqsA/PqsD/PqsE/PqsH, mutant kinetic, downstream signalling or antimicrobial target claim is imported from background citations.
discussions.notes: Main text, methods, tables and captions were inspected; figure pixels and the supplementary movie were not. Source-owned producer grades, origin and ontology grounding are unchanged. Owner SMILES/InChI/key agree under RDKit 2026.03.5. The pinned CHEBI:62219 SMILES fails parsing and was excluded from identity proof. The valid CHEBI:75306 hydroxy tautomer shares the owner StandardInChIKey, which does not adjudicate the existing ChEBI ambiguity.
